### 2026-10-09 – Finally done the PCB for my SwiChain macropad thing! I decided to add some LEDs on the back (WS2812) and added two more keys, because the 18650 is wider than I remembered. Also I added some art becaus

**3h**

Finally done the PCB for my SwiChain macropad thing! I decided to add some LEDs on the back (WS2812) and added two more keys, because the 18650 is wider than I remembered. Also I added some art because I dunno if I wanna 3D print a case for it or just use a bare PCB. Overall I'm surprised I did this in like 7 hours and am really happy with how it's looking! Tomorrow I'll do some configuring with ZMK firmware and I'll be done with everything :D
